title: Transgenic Fruit Flies vs. Cell Lines: Eliminating Bioreactor Bottlenecks
summary: Why Stability is Important for Scalability Most recombinant protein expression projects stall in the transition from pilot-scale discovery to large-scale manufacturing. While bench-scale transient methods can rapidly yield gram-level quantities for initial characterization, they present critical limitations at scale, such as plasmid loss and decreased expression that can compromise protein folding and biological activity.
